# TASK-083 — specification

## Scope

Document exports: shared Markdown parser with LaTeX (report class, longtable/booktabs tables, lists, verbatim, links, polyglossia) and print-ready HTML renderers (`document-render.ts`); formats `html`, `svg` (overview image, `overview-image.ts`), `pdf` (direct from the isolated publisher, `reports` flag, 503 when unconfigured) and `speckit`; PNG conversion in the browser (`OverviewImage`); rendered HTML and SVG served with a `default-src 'none'` CSP. `publisherPdf()` extracted to `pdf-publisher.ts`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Exports as LaTeX, printable HTML, PDF and image (SVG overview, PNG in the browser); better tables in rendered documents.

## Verification

- tests/exports.test.ts
